A staircase with a handrail (added to the building in 1969) is on the west side of this elevation to allow pedestrian access from the elevated street grade at the back (west) of the building. The west elevation is blank except for a roof access ladder. This resource has eight accessory resources (AR). AR1: Loading Dock This is a cast-in-place loading dock off of the east elevation of the building. The loading dock was built at the same time as the building. Underneath the dock are power hookups for trailers. These hookups were installed in 1971 along with AR3 and AR4. AR2: Retaining Wall This is a concrete retaining wall that extends from the south side of the building and was present by 1968. AR3: Trailer Hookups These are on the south side of the building and are installed along the retaining wall (AR2). AR4: Trailer Hookups This is a freestanding metal and wood frame with various trailer hookups. AR5: Substation This is substation that provides power to the diagnostic trailer hookups. AR6: Substation This is the 6-1-4160-1-3 Substation. It consists of a fenced enclosure with electrical equipment sitting on a concrete pad. It is located on the west side of the building. AR7: Storage Boxcar This is a storage boxcar in the same dirt lot as the building adjacent to Mercury Highway. AR8: Parking Lot This is the paved lot used for parking of vehicles and trailers at Building 06-CP-50. 8.
